note: Owner rulings on flow outcomes the checks cannot decide (extra content on an OPEN request). pending = undetermined, shown as a count and never counted as a pass. A ruling is frozen BEFORE a candidate is judged; never loosen it after seeing candidate output. Any change bumps `version`, and results record the version they were judged under.

rulings.decidedBy: agent, on the owner's instruction "你幫我決定" (2026-11-13)
rulings.basis: DECISION_PRINCIPLES C1 (do not overturn what the owner already decided): the product prompt the owner approved says the reply should hold only what the user asked for ("actions 要精簡，只放使用者要求的內容"). The user in FL5 later names exact children (淺草寺、澀谷…), so a generic group the user did not name is an extra.
